note: Evil Mode founding text and starting rules (design Part 3 sections 1, 3, 7 and 11; Part 29 sections 2 and 3). Text is data. Numbers are starting values, not playtested.
opening: You can't stop the Hero. You can decide what they find.
You'll be shown the cost of everything before you choose it.
Nobody on your team can be made into someone else.
oldLookLine: Evil Mode uses the New look. Your setting hasn't been changed.
confirmLine: All of this is permanent except the Line.

lines.name: Clean hands
lines.feel: Slow, poor, and safe. The team can't take anything it isn't given or doesn't win.

lines.name: Grey
lines.feel: The standard game. Everything's possible and everything's on the Card.

lines.name: Whatever it takes
lines.feel: Fast and rich. The best perks. People leave, and the game makes that felt and not fatal.

beats.name: Morning
beats.empty: The kettle's on. Nobody's asked for anything yet.

beats.name: Dispatch
beats.empty: No jobs on the board today. The squads play cards.

beats.name: In person
beats.empty: Nothing needs the Boss in person. You stay in.

beats.name: Evening
beats.empty: Nothing came back, because nothing went out. A quiet table.

beats.name: The Hero
beats.empty: Somewhere a kid is walking. Not here. Not yet.
